name: Pristina (Kosovo)
description: A light-blue field charged at the centre with the arms of Pristina: a shield bearing the Neolithic 'Goddess on the Throne' figurine found at Ulpiana.
history: The municipality's arms show the terracotta 'Goddess on the Throne' excavated near the city in 1956, which became Pristina's symbol; the flag bearing them has no published adoption date.

features.role: shield with the Goddess on the Throne figurine
features.symbolism: the Neolithic Vinča-culture idol, the city's emblem
